default.description: Minimum capability set for the Zenith main window. No filesystem scope is granted: every file operation goes through a typed command in the Rust core. The window permissions exist because the window is undecorated, so the three controls a title bar would draw are drawn by the renderer instead.

setup.description: The 640x420 frameless installer window. It gets window control and drag permissions only: the wizard talks to the installer process, not to the machine, so it holds no command, filesystem or dialog permission beyond the title bar buttons it draws itself.
